description: Add slash commands to export current merged settings to a file and import settings from a file. This makes it easier to share configurations between projects or team members.

phases.name: Core Export/Import Functions
phases.description: Implement the core functions for exporting and importing settings in settings.py

subtasks.title: Add export_settings function
subtasks.description: Create export_settings(root_dir: Path, output_path: Path) function that loads merged settings and writes them to a JSON file. Should exclude session-specific fields (last_session, agents) and only export configuration settings.
acceptance_criteria: Function loads merged settings via load_settings()
Excludes last_session and agents fields from export
Writes to specified output path using _write_json pattern

subtasks.title: Add settings_to_dict helper
subtasks.description: Create helper function to convert KaiSettings dataclass to dict, filtering out None values and session-specific fields for clean export.

subtasks.title: Add import_settings function
subtasks.description: Create import_settings(input_path: Path, target: str, root_dir: Path) function that reads settings from a JSON file and writes to the appropriate settings file (global/project/local).
acceptance_criteria: Reads and validates JSON from input path
Merges with existing settings (doesn't clobber unspecified fields)
Validates settings keys are known KaiSettings fields

subtasks.title: Add validate_settings_dict helper
subtasks.description: Create helper function to validate that imported settings dict contains only valid KaiSettings fields with correct types.
acceptance_criteria: Validates all keys are valid KaiSettings fields
Validates value types match expected types
Allows both snake_case and camelCase keys

phases.name: Slash Command Handlers
phases.description: Implement the slash command handlers in rich_commands.py

subtasks.title: Add /export-settings command handler
subtasks.description: Add handler for /export-settings [filename] command that exports current merged settings to a file. Default filename is 'kai-settings.json' if not specified.

subtasks.title: Add /import-settings command handler
subtasks.description: Add handler for /import-settings <filename> [--target global|project|local] command that imports settings from a file. Default target is 'project'.
acceptance_criteria: Shows success/error message with imported fields

subtasks.title: Register commands in handle_command function
subtasks.description: Add the new commands to the handle_command() function's command routing.
acceptance_criteria: Commands work with or without arguments

subtasks.title: Update /help command output
subtasks.description: Add the new commands to the help text shown by /help command.
acceptance_criteria: Both commands listed in help output
Grouped logically with other settings-related info

phases.name: Tests
phases.description: Add comprehensive tests for the export/import functionality

subtasks.title: Add unit tests for settings export/import functions
subtasks.description: Create tests/test_settings_export_import.py with tests for export_settings, import_settings, and helper functions.
acceptance_criteria: Tests export_settings creates valid JSON file
Tests exported file excludes session fields
Tests import_settings reads and applies settings
Tests merge behavior preserves existing settings

subtasks.title: Add integration tests for slash commands
subtasks.description: Add tests for the slash command handlers to ensure they properly parse arguments and call the appropriate functions.
acceptance_criteria: Tests error handling for missing files
Tests error handling for invalid JSON

final_acceptance: Running /export-settings creates a valid JSON file with current settings
Running /import-settings <file> applies settings to project config
Both commands show appropriate success/error messages
Help text updated with new commands

patterns_to_follow: Use existing _read_json/_write_json helpers for file I/O
Follow handle_command() routing pattern for slash commands
Use console.print() for user feedback following existing style
Use dataclasses.asdict() or similar for KaiSettings serialization
key_files: src/kai_code/cli_ui.py - Help text and UI utilities
considerations: Session-specific fields (last_session, agents) should NOT be exported/imported
Import should merge with existing settings, not replace entirely
Support both snake_case and camelCase for compatibility
